syllabus_topics: Recalls of continuous automatics: signals and systems, Laplace transform, transfer functions (in particular 1st and 2nd order), temporal response, frequency analysis, stability, precision, feedback principles and synthesis of control laws in the frequency domain.

Sampled automatics: sampling, digital-to-analog converters, analog-to-digital converters, signal processing basics, choice of sampling period, Z-transform, 0-order hold, Z-transfer function, stability analysis, controller synthesis by polynomial approaches (Dead-beat response, Zdan, RST)
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
